name: Gas fuel price and delivered-energy cost evidence
description: Fuel assumptions and realised fuel-cost evidence. Lazard's $3.45/MMBtu is a modelling assumption held constant for year-over-year comparison, not a market quote; IEEFA and Rabobank quote forecasts separately.

capex.metric: gas fuel price assumption for Lazard LCOE
capex.basis: Lazard LCOE+ v18.0 assumption for gas-fired generation, held for year-over-year comparison; +/-25% sensitivity uses $2.59-4.31/MMBtu
EIA February 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook as quoted by IEEFA
EIA February 2026 STEO as quoted by IEEFA
Wood Mackenzie projection quoted by IEEFA

capex.metric: realised annual fuel cost, Dominion Greensville 1,588 MW CCGT
capex.basis: 11.5 million MWh generated; EIA data analysed by IEEFA; plant heat rate about 6,500 Btu/kWh

capex.metric: realised annual fuel cost, Dominion Greensville 1,588 MW CCGT
capex.basis: 11.1 million MWh generated; increase of more than $200m following Russia's invasion of Ukraine; costs passed through to customers

capex.metric: modelled cost of power from Greensville at 2027 gas price
capex.basis: IEEFA estimate: from $27.10/MWh five-year operating average to $38.50/MWh at $4.40/MMBtu; annual fuel cost from about $295m to more than $417m

capex.metric: year-5 delivered cost, on-site gas generation
capex.basis: HTR bank model at gas $3.5/MMBtu, grade D: recip engines ~$107/MWh, aero-derivatives ~$106/MWh, on-site combined cycle ~$101/MWh; US industrial grid supply ~$86/MWh (EIA 2025)

capex.metric: illustrative all-in recip engine delivered price
capex.basis: Market analyst estimate, grade D, quoted by HTR

capex.metric: Henry Hub weekly average during Winter Storm Fern
capex.basis: Week ended 23 January 2026; highest weekly price since Winter Storm Uri, February 2021, quoted by IEEFA

sources.note: Fuel assumptions and realised fuel-cost evidence. Lazard's $3.45/MMBtu is a mode

gaps.what: Firm gas transportation contract price for a specific data-centre plant
gaps.why: IEEFA states these agreements are generally not publicly available
gaps.next_action: Seek FERC gas tariff filings or state commission exhibits
